the ArcLance frontend expects at P2P_ADDRESS (Arc Testnet). Non-custodial: the seller's USDC (ERC-20 interface, 6 decimals) is locked in this contract and is released to the buyer only when the seller calls confirmPayment (or by dispute resolution). Ad side (uint8): 0 SELL  the advertiser sells USDC; USDC is locked in createAd.                  1 BUY   the advertiser buys USDC; the seller who takes the order locks USDC in createOrder. price: fiat units per 1 USDC, scaled by 1e6 (281.5 PKR per USDC = 281_500_000). fiatAmount (in Order) = amount * price / 1e6, scaled by 1e6 like price. paymentMethods bitmask: 1 Bank transfer, 2 JazzCash, 4 Easypaisa, 8 UPI, 16 bKash, 32 Mobile money. currency: \"PKR\", \"INR\", \"BDT\" or \"NGN\". Order status (uint8): 0 Created (waiting for payment), 1 Paid, 2 Completed, 3 Cancelled, 4 Disputed. Order.expiresAt = createdAt + ad.paymentWindowMinutes * 60.
